newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Triplenic buys hotel in Xiamen, China.
newsitem.headline: Triplenic buys hotel in Xiamen, China.

text.p: Triplenic Holding Ltd said on Sunday that it will acquire Xiamen Plaza Hotel from China Investments Holdings Ltd for HK$135 million.

The hotel in Xiamen in eastern China was formed as a joint venture between China Investemtns and Shanghai Railway Bureau Xiamen Railway Development Co, under which the foreign partner was entitled to all revenue generated from the property after deducting a fixed fee payable to Shanghai Railway.
Following the transfer of interests, Triplenic will hold 100 percent equity and loan interest and management rights, while Shanghai Railway will continue to own the land rights.

The consideration of HK$135 million will be paid through an asset swap. Triplenic will assign to China Investments certain properties in Hong Kong, which is also expected to generate a book profit of HK$90 million for the company.
In addition, Triplenic will pay China Investments an amount equal to the net current assets of the hotel property as of the date of completion of the agreement.
Xiamen Plaza Hotel is a 287-room three-star hotel in Xiamen in the coastal province of Fujian. Triplenic said it is planning a HK$15 million facelift to work toward a four-star rating.
